name: PagerLinks
description: Mortar documentation pager links, using central semantic tokens.

props.id: string (the root element's id, e.g. an in-page link target)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)
props.label: string (navigation landmark name; default "Previous and next page")

contract.usage: Import { PagerLinks } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. Name the landmark with label so it stays distinct from Pagination. Arrows are hidden from assistive technology.
